planning_notes: Board is arduino:avr:uno. Wiring includes only D13 as a digital output for the LED; no additional pins were supplied or authorized.
Serial receive is implemented via serial_command_input at 9600 baud with commands OFF=1 and ON=2; framing defaults to line_or_idle with idle_timeout_ms=20 per provided configuration.

Control-period granularity is set to 10 ms as a reasonable scheduling step; business logic timing (applying the received command to D13) is handled in the SysML model upon io_valid for one control step.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: LED switch controlled by serial command (ON=2 sets LED on, OFF=1 sets LED off)

interfaces.name: io_1_valid
interfaces.meaning: True for this model step only when a complete valid serial frame was received; value holds its previous value otherwise
